method: Parse the fixed upstream SVGs; scale every source line/polyline coordinate by exactly 2/3; translate menu by (1.5,1.5). Set target viewport and stroke width 1.7. Compare every resulting vertex to current public observations, allowing line order and polyline direction reversal only. Retain round cap/join style.
